description: Ordered feature vector used by both the Python training pipeline and the Kotlin on-device inference. Order is significant: index i in this list is column i of the model input. Every feature is computed ONLY from the current sample and earlier samples of the same monitoring session (no future information).
pressure_rule: A sample is 'under resource pressure' when low_memory == 1 OR mem_margin_ratio < 0.05 OR thermal_status >= 3 (THERMAL_STATUS_SEVERE).
window_rule: Window samples are those of the same session with timestamp_ms > t_now - window_seconds*1000 and timestamp_ms <= t_now (current sample included).
missing_rule: Unavailable measurements are NaN in the feature vector and replaced at inference time by the training-set median exported with the model (imputation map).

features.name: mem_margin_ratio
features.definition: (availMem - MemoryInfo.threshold) / totalMem; negative means below Android's low-memory threshold

features.name: thermal_headroom
features.definition: PowerManager.getThermalHeadroom(10s forecast); 1.0 = throttling threshold; NaN if unsupported/unreliable

features.name: is_charging
features.definition: Battery status CHARGING or FULL while plugged

features.name: mem_ratio_mean_w
features.definition: Mean of mem_avail_ratio over the window

features.name: mem_ratio_std_w
features.definition: Population standard deviation (ddof=0) of mem_avail_ratio over the window

features.name: mem_ratio_slope_w
features.definition: Least-squares slope of mem_avail_ratio against time in minutes over the window; 0 when fewer than 2 samples

features.name: thermal_delta_w
features.definition: Current thermal_status minus minimum non-missing thermal_status in window; NaN if current is missing

features.name: pressure_fraction_w
features.definition: Fraction of window samples satisfying the pressure rule

features.name: sample_gap_s
features.definition: Seconds since previous sample of the same session; NaN for the first sample

features.name: completeness_w
features.definition: min(1, n_window_samples / floor(window_seconds / interval_s)) where interval_s is the configured sampling interval
